title: When the Hollow Wakes Again
author: Wren Yarrow
blurb: Oscar Delacroix, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
